adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the Zod safeParse result object (with .success/.data), not the parsed data itself (it mutates refreshTokenResponse.data then `return refreshTokenResponse`). In GoogleCalendarService (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts), the returned value is assigned to `key` and persisted directly via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, meaning the credential key stored in DB becomes `{ success: true, data: {...} }` instead of the expected credential shape. This is inconsistent with prior behavior (`googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)` returned the plain object) and will break later consumers that expect the credential schema at `credential.key`.
